proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for calibre-web, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the calibre-web service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the calibre-web
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  calibre-web:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.calibre-web.loadbalancer.server.port=8083
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.rule=Host(`calibre-web.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.service=calibre-web
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web.middlewares=authentik@docker
      # API paths stay open so client applications keep working.
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web-api.rule=Host(`calibre-web.example.com`) && (PathPrefix(`/opds`) || PathPrefix(`/kobo`))
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web-api.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web-api.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web-api.service=calibre-web
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-web-api.priority=100

kubernetes:
# Calibre-web: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-calibre-web/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: calibre-web-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: calibre-web-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: calibre-web-books
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: calibre-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: calibre-web
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre-web:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: calibre-web-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8083
          containerPort: 8083
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: calibre-web-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: calibre-web-books
          mountPath: /books
      volumes:
      - name: calibre-web-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: calibre-web-config
      - name: calibre-web-books
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: calibre-web-books
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: calibre-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre-web
  ports:
  - name: port-8083
    port: 8083
    targetPort: 8083
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# calibre-web.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-calibre-web/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Calibre-web (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre-web:latest
ContainerName=calibre-web
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=DOCKER_MODS=linuxserver/mods:universal-calibre
# Environment=OAUTHLIB_RELAX_TOKEN_SCOPE=1
Volume=/path/to/calibre-web/data:/config:Z
Volume=/path/to/calibre/library:/books:Z
PublishPort=8083:8083

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
